name: promptgate
description: Lets clear prompts through untouched and rewrites rough ones into the prompt box for you to check before sending.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: fill puts the rewrite in the prompt box, replace sends it, context adds a hint, off does nothing

optimizerModel.title: Classifier model
optimizerModel.description: Model that decides whether a prompt is rough

minChars.title: Minimum length
minChars.description: Prompts shorter than this pass through untouched
